pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Stellate and irregular polygonal dark regions exhibiting high-frequency edge oscillations and sharp pixel-level gradients; spatial area is maximal on the mid-flank and reduces toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a topological lattice; junction nodes exhibit expanded spatial area compared to connecting segments of variable pixel width.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette visible along the cervical spine, composed of dense, vertically-oriented hair structures.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct reduction in mane height and density is observed at the anatomical transition between the neck and the dorsal ridge.
